name: glob-hide-files
description: Hide files matching a glob (or list of globs), and toggle them back into view from the command palette.

globHideFiles.patterns.markdownDescription: Globs to hide while hiding is enabled, e.g. `**/*.lock`, `node_modules`, `**/*.{png,jpg}`. These use the same syntax as `#files.exclude#` and are matched relative to the workspace folder.

globHideFiles.hiddenByDefault.markdownDescription: Whether files start out hidden the first time a workspace is opened. After that, the toggle state is remembered per workspace.

enumDescriptions: Write to your user settings. Nothing is written into the project, so no git-tracked files change.
Write to the workspace's settings, so hiding only affects this workspace. Note that this modifies .vscode/settings.json (or the .code-workspace file), which is often tracked by git.
globHideFiles.configurationTarget.markdownDescription: Where the generated `#files.exclude#` entries are written. `global` keeps the project clean; `workspace` scopes hiding to this project but modifies `.vscode/settings.json`, which is often tracked by git. Always falls back to user settings when no folder is open.

globHideFiles.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a status bar item indicating whether files are currently hidden.
